title: Chorizo Pilaf
description: A flavorful Syrian-inspired pilaf dish featuring spicy chorizo sausage

ingredients.name: Roasted vegetables (such as carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: Heat the knockout oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chorizo sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and crispy.
Add the chopped roasted vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the chorizo and vegetables.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the pilaf is lightly toasted and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
